# Gfx

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

The caller's graphics session. Use `Terminal.Gfx` to select a backend and control frame pacing.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#graphics).

## Backend

`Gfx.Backend: GfxBackend`

Read-only instance property.

The selected read-only `GfxBackend`, or `None` when no graphics session is active.

## Init

```PPL
Gfx.Init([GfxBackend backend], [BOOLEAN fullscreen]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Starts a graphics session with the requested `GfxBackend`. `Auto` chooses the best terminal capability; fullscreen defaults to `TRUE`.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** `Auto` uses negotiated Sixel/JPEG-XL capabilities; an explicit Sixel request performs no additional probe. Fullscreen sends `CSI 2 J`, `CSI H`, then `CSI ? 25 l`, `CSI ? 7 l`, `CSI ? 80 l`, and `CSI ? 1070 l`. Sixel requires Sixel DCS support; JPEG XL requires SyncTERM/CTerm media APC support.

## SetPacing

```PPL
Gfx.SetPacing(BOOLEAN enabled) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Enables or disables frame pacing and returns whether it succeeded. When enabled, presentation waits for terminal acknowledgement before sending another frame. On failure, `Error.Last()` provides details.

## Shutdown

```PPL
Gfx.Shutdown() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Ends the graphics session and restores normal text output.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** fullscreen sends `CSI ? 80 h`, `CSI ? 7 h`, and `CSI ? 25 h`. After Sixel output it restores all 16 DOS colors with OSC 4, then sends SGR reset `CSI 0 m` and restores the board color.
